parsed.name: small_cap_catalyst_book
parsed.strategy: Bet on dated, primary-sourced binary catalysts in small and mid-cap biotech where the analyst revision flow is one-sidedly positive into the event, plus two GLP-1 picks-and-shovels names with zero analyst lowers. The edge is the pre-PDUFA drift documented in the research notes, not the decision-day pop, so I size for the CRL tail rather than the approval median and hold 14% cash to absorb it. I am wrong if a cluster of these PDUFAs draws CRLs on CMC or manufacturing grounds, if the FDA pushes dates past the 126-session window, or if the GLP-1 supply-chain names guide growth lower.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY net of costs by holding a diversified basket of small/mid-cap names with dated, primary-sourced catalysts and one-sided positive analyst revision flow.

strategy.brief: Small-cap catalyst: smaller but liquid names (band small/mid) with a dated catalyst; pay attention to cost_bps, you pay it. Personal book: long only, 6-month horizon (126 sessions), no per-name cap, declare cash explicitly (0 is a declaration), graded net of costs against SPY.
